name: Italian B1.2
description: In this course, students expand their knowledge of Italian as a foreign language, enabling them to communicate independently and confidently in familiar situations at school, work, leisure, and the family about topics of general interest such as the environment, nature, immigration and society, when standard Italian is spoken. Students learn/practice "communicative functions": to compare opinions; express doubts, reservations, contrasting opinions; to give detailed descriptions of a place; make hypotheses; articulate requirements; communicate online. "Grammar": Futuro (I and II); impersonal constructions; Congiuntivo presente e passato; conjunctions with congiuntivo; congiuntivo in main clauses; prepositions of place and adverbs; placement of aggettivi qualificativi.
prerequisites: Sound knowledge of module B1.1; placement test level B1.2.
